notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now, or call 911 if you feel faint, confused, drowsy or short of breath or have no safe ride — do not drive yourself. Very high sugar with repeated vomiting and being unable to keep fluids down can mean a dangerous diabetic emergency that needs blood tests and IV treatment today. I recommend Counsel stay involved for follow-up afterwards.
